certification.name: Certified Enterprise Security Professional - AD CS
certification.description: Covers Active Directory Certificate Services enumeration, certificate theft, privilege escalation through template and CA misconfigurations, persistence and forged certificates. Assessed by a 24-hour hands-on exam in a patched AD CS environment followed by a report; the renewal exam is free before expiry.
certification.currency_note: 30-day lab access with one exam attempt; extra attempts $99
